records.title: 10-Q
records.text: While operating revenue increased $47 million, the improvement was offset by a $44 million increase in fuel costs and a $4 million increase in non-fuel operating expenses.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: On a consolidated basis, Passenger revenue for the third quarter of 2022 increased by $841 million, or 47%, driven by a 22% increase in passenger traffic and a 21% improvement in ticket yields.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase was driven by incremental departure related costs on 13% more flown capacity, as well as higher wages and training costs.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the third quarter non-fuel operating expense, excluding special items, increased 24% over the prior year period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the first nine months of 2022, net cash provided by operating activities was $1.4 billion, compared to $901 million during the same period in 2021.
